The v0.42.0 cut moved the version string. `design_holds` because the design meaning of a cut lives in the Release node and its epoch, not in a version literal — nothing about what this project IS changed here.

⚠️ ACCEPTED BEFORE `release_includes_all` RUNS, deliberately. That tool freezes each artifact's CURRENT checksum, so accepting after it would record that v0.42.0 shipped the PRE-BUMP file. Doing it in this order is one step; the other order is a gate failure and a second export.
